name: Staff of the Freed Man
body:
Source Champions of Purity pg. 31
Aura moderate varies CL 17th
Slot none; Price 51,688 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Description
Just over 7 feet tall and topped with what looks like a large iron skeleton key, this unassuming oaken staff appears to be nothing but a common walking stick. It allows use of the following spells:
Detect secret doors (2 charges)
Knock (2 charges)
Passwall (3 charges)
Freedom (5 charges)
Construction
Requirements Craft Staff, detect secret doors, freedom, knock, passwall; Cost 25,840 gp
